messages:
maya: quick sync — customer asks for explicit token billing fields + trace IDs in responses. want to align across chat/embeddings/rerank.
devin: +1. can we avoid duplicating names across endpoints? e.g. 'token_usage' vs 'tokens' vs 'billing' — pick one.
samir: prefer token_usage with subfields: input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens. matches ML evals.
elaine: UX note: SDKs will expose a .usage object. want stable names for 1.0.
chad: launch criteria we discussed: backward compatible default, opt-in enriched metadata for early customers, doc + changelog, 90d deprecate window. ok?
maya: proposed minimal fields for GA: model, model_version, token_usage.{input_tokens,output_tokens,total_tokens}, trace_id, latency_ms, cost_usd (estimated). keep nested but flat-friendly keys.
devin: nesting is fine in JSON but many customers stream lines into logging systems that prefer flat keys. suggestion: provide both? e.g. response.metadata and response.metadata_flat. tradeoffs?
samir: both increases payload size. alternative: keep canonical nested shape and publish a flattening mapping in SDKs/console.
elaine: +1 on SDK mapping. we should not bloat the wire format. also, need a consistent trace id name: x-request-id vs trace_id vs request_id.
chad: ops wants trace_id that correlates with internal jaeger traces. prefer 'trace_id' with 128-bit hex.
devin: technical: we'll generate trace_id server-side and echo in response header and body. header X-Trace-Id, body trace_id. ok for security?
samir: be mindful of PII in metadata. token counts are fine. cost_usd should be an estimate rounded to 6 decimals? probably cents precision OK.
maya: customers also asked for model variant + quantization info (e.g., 'model_version' and 'quantization' or 'model_variant'). add to minimal GA fields.
devin: okay. draft response schema (example):
```json
{
  "id": "resp_123",
  "model": "redwood-7b",
  "model_version": "2026-02-14",
  "quantization": "4bit",
  "output": { "text": "..." },
  "metadata": {
    "trace_id": "0af3...",
    "latency_ms": 42,
    "cost_usd": 0.00054,
    "token_usage": { "input_tokens": 12, "output_tokens": 34, "total_tokens": 46 }
  }
}
```
elaine: looks good. add a small example for tool-calling and structured output so teams know how to wire trace_id through tools.
maya: launch checklist bullets: 1) stable schema + docs, 2) SDK updates (JS/Python), 3) sample migration guide, 4) telemetry to validate adoption, 5) opt-in flag for enriched metadata.
chad: product asks: which endpoints first? I'd vote chat/completions then embeddings then rerank/tool-calling. embeddings customers care about input_token only.
samir: embeddings: token counts should reflect tokenization used for embedding model. also include embed_dim and model_version.
devin: scope negotiation: we can land chat/completions + headers + body trace_id in 2 sprints, SDKs following sprint. embeddings + rerank next milestone. tool-calling structured-output will need additional QA (schema evolution tests).
maya: any blockers? privacy/compliance?
elaine: GDPR concern: don't include user-identifying metadata in responses. trace_id must be opaque. document retention guidelines.
chad: commercial: add deprecation language and a migration timeline in release notes.
product-bot: deploy-notice: feature-flag 'response-metadata-v1' created for canary testing in prod region us-west-2.
devin: canary plan: flip flag for internal customers, then beta customers, then GA. collect telemetry: request->response token deltas and stripe billing estimates.
maya: decision: use 'token_usage' as canonical name, 'trace_id' canonical trace field, nested metadata object, SDKs provide flat mapping. prioritize chat GA, embeddings next, rerank/tooling later.
samir: noted. i'll add validation tests for token counts and trace propagation.
elaine: i'll draft SDK PRs and the migration guide.
chad: i'll prepare the rollout comms and deprecation schedule.
maya: thanks all — will add these actions to the roadmap doc and set follow-up for next Wed. :calendar:
